seo__search_description: Get in touch with Oakdene House Foundation in Fairfield, Western Sydney. Call (02) 8717 0999 or email admin@oakdenehouse.org.au
hero__subheading: Whether you are looking for support, information, a referral pathway, or community connection — we are here to help.
contact_cards__text_2: Give us a call during business hours
contact_cards__text_4: Send us an email and we will get back to you
contact_cards__text_7: Parking via Fairfield RSL open air car park, corner of Vine and Bertha Streets
contact_cards__text_11: Some programs run outside these hours. Check each program page for times.
service_specific_contacts__subheading: Kitchen, Food Packs, Laundrette & Used Clothing Store
language_support_postal_abn__text: We offer support in multiple languages. If you need an interpreter, please let us know when you contact us and we will arrange one for you.
enquiry_form__heading: We'd love to hear from you
enquiry_form__intro: Whether you're looking for support, interested in one of our programs, considering a partnership, or just want to know more about Oakdene — send us a message and we'll be in touch within 2 business days.
contact_form__success_heading: **Thanks — your message has been sent. We'll be in touch within 2 business days.**
contact_form__success_message: If you need support urgently, please call us on [(02) 8717 0999](tel:+61287170999) during business hours, or visit our [Need Help Now](/need-help-now/) page for 24/7 support.
contact_form__consent: I understand my enquiry will be handled in line with Oakdene's [privacy policy](/privacy-policy/).
cta__subheading: If you need immediate help, visit our Need Help Now page for crisis lines and emergency contacts.
